items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: one night one of America's biggest gangsters came to Connie's and I talked with him. He was Dutch Shultz.

ctx.x: When Snake Hips hit the one who had thrown the hot piece, the others - three men - jumped up to defend their friend. But some of the waiters were already standing at their table, so they dug and froze. Connie came up and ordered them to pay their bill and get the hell out of there before he took a poke at one of them.

I never cared for gangsters the same as many other people, but one night one of America's biggest gangsters came to Connie's and I talked with him. He was Dutch Shultz. Dutch was a big man with a pleasant voice when we talked together. I don't remember what the conversation was but I know that I did not ask him how many guns he
carried or how many men were in his gang.
